summary: The Assemblies of God's Statement of Fundamental Truths says the Church is the body of Christ and the habitation of God through the Spirit, and that each believer, born of the Spirit, is an integral part of the general assembly and church of the firstborn. The Assemblies of God sees itself as an agency for evangelizing the world, a body for worship and a channel to build up saints. A divinely called and scripturally ordained ministry leads the Church in evangelization, worship and building up the body. The statement does not describe church government or say who may be ordained.

points.question: Where is the true church?
points.answer: The Church is the body of Christ; each believer born of the Spirit is an integral part of the general assembly and church of the firstborn.

points.question: Who may lead?
points.answer: A divinely called and scripturally ordained ministry leads the Church in evangelization, worship and building up the saints.
